details: For finite concept classes; projected recursive teaching dimension is a lower bound for order compression. Theorem 24 in the cached author-hosted preprint dated August 26, 2014 (the previous pointer to Theorem 4 did not specify a version).
name: Order Sample Compression / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
witness_verification: The 109-concept Chen Neighbor Puncture has projected RTD exactly four, certified on all 4096 projections, but OSC at least five: its five-trace completion contains the RTD-five Chen base. See database values #1118/#1119 and survey Proposition prop:osc-projected-rtd-separation. This refutes equality, not a reverse affine bound; no unbounded witness is claimed.
proof: In the cached August 26, 2014 author-hosted preprint, Theorem 14 restricts an order scheme to any coordinate projection without increasing its size. The teaching-plan argument of Lemma 23 lower-bounds the resulting order-scheme size by the recursive teaching dimension of that projection. Taking the maximum over projections is Theorem 24. See the survey's literature/darnstadt2016order source packet for the exact version and statement numbers.
